title: PAN Card Verification: How to Check PAN Card Details Online
summary: Learn how to check PAN card details online, verify your PAN status and confirm the cardholder name. See how businesses can verify PANs in bulk.

PAN, which stands for Permanent Account Number, is a unique number that the government issues to identify taxpayers in India. When you perform a PAN card check to verify details, you can find your PAN, name, date of birth, and signature on the card. PAN is mandatory for specified financial transactions and activities, such as opening a bank account or carrying out other specified high-value financial transactions.


The PAN or Permanent Account Number is a 10-character alphanumeric code for unique identification and has lifetime validity. PAN number verification is the process through which individuals can check the validity of their PAN cards and whether their details match government records.


So, what is the process for PAN verification and how can people check their PAN card details? In this comprehensive guide, we will cover how to verify your PAN card.


### TL;DR


- To verify your PAN number online, use the Income Tax e-Filing portal. Enter your PAN, full name, date of birth, and a mobile number you can access, then validate the OTP.
- The portal checks the details you enter and displays your PAN status. You need to enter the card holder’s name yourself.
- Businesses can verify PANs individually or in bulk using Cashfree Secure ID’s dashboard or API.


##


How to Check PAN Card Details Online and Verify Your PAN Number


The Income Tax Department of India offers the **Verify PAN Status** service for online PAN verification. Individuals can use it on the e-Filing portal without logging in.


You can easily perform a PAN card check by following a few simple steps.


1. Open the[Income Tax e-Filing portal](https://www.incometax.gov.in/iec/foportal/) .
2. Go to the **Quick Links** section and then click on **Verify PAN Status** .
3. Enter the full name and date of birth (D.O.B.) as per the PAN card, as well as the PAN number. Also, enter a mobile number you can access and select **Continue** .
4. Enter the six-digit OTP sent to that mobile number and select **Validate** to see the PAN card status.


### PAN Card Holder Name Check Online


To check a PAN card holder’s name, enter the full name as it appears on the PAN card along with the PAN number and date of birth. The portal checks the details you provide and displays the PAN status after OTP validation. The public service requires you to supply the name and date of birth, so a PAN number alone is insufficient.


##


Who Can Check PAN Card Details or Do PAN Verification?


Various people do PAN verification for different purposes. Here are some examples.


- **Individuals.** To verify their own PAN details. They can also verify the PAN details of a person they are authorised to assist, provided they have all the required information.
- **Banks and other fintech organisations.** To verify customer identity. They generally use bulk PAN verification to check whether the PAN is active and if the PAN details are authentic. Before onboarding somebody or conducting business with them, it is important to verify their PAN details where required.
- **Employers.** To verify their employees’ PANs for TDS.
- **Tax deductors.** To verify the deductee’s PAN for the purpose of TDS.
- **Property buyers.** To verify the property seller’s PAN for TDS where it applies.
- **Tenants.** To collect the landlord’s PAN if the annual rent paid exceeds ₹1 lakh and the tenant is submitting HRA documentation.


##


PAN Card Verification with Cashfree Payments


With Cashfree Payments, businesses can do single or bulk PAN verification through[Secure ID](https://www.cashfree.com/kyc-verification) . Here’s how.


### Individual PAN Verification


To verify an individual PAN on Cashfree, follow these[steps](https://www.cashfree.com/docs/secure-id/kyc-stack/verify-pan) .


1. Go to the **Secure ID Dashboard** , select **PAN** , and click on **Verify PAN** .
2. Enter your PAN and name to proceed.
3. Click on **Verify** . If the PAN is verified successfully, you will see a success message.


In the **Secure ID → PAN** screen, every PAN that you check will be visible and available for your reference. Based on the status (Valid, Invalid, Rejected, Verification Failed), specified time period, and PAN type, you can search and filter for the details.


### Bulk PAN Card Verification


Cashfree Payments helps you with[bulk PAN verification through APIs](https://www.cashfree.com/docs/api-reference/vrs/v2/pan/verify-pan-in-bulk) . You can verify a[single PAN](https://www.cashfree.com/docs/api-reference/vrs/v2/pan/verify-pan-sync) or submit up to 10,000 PANs in bulk through the API. The[bulk status response](https://www.cashfree.com/docs/api-reference/vrs/v2/pan/get-status-for-verify-pan-in-bulk) gives you access to information like:


- Name of PAN holder (as per the government records)
- The name printed on the PAN card, where available
- PAN type (business or individual)
- Verification ID
- PAN validation status


When you have a large number of PANs to verify, you can do it in one batch through the dashboard. Upload a .csv, .xls, or .xlsx file containing the PAN and name of the individual or business and verify them all at once. Use the sample file in the dashboard to format the entries.


**Steps to upload a batch file containing PAN information**


1. Go to the **Secure ID Dashboard → Batch** and click **Upload File** .
2. Click on **Choose a File** to select the upload file and click **Upload** . The uploaded file will be visible in the **Batch** section.
3. To view the status of the PAN details, click the uploaded file.


All PANs you verify will be visible and accessible in the **Secure ID → PAN** dashboard. You can search by file name and filter the results by status (Processed, Processing, Rejected, Cancelled) or time duration. You can also download the[PAN verification report](https://www.cashfree.com/docs/secure-id/reports/pan-verification-report) for a selected date range.


##


Who Requires Bulk PAN Verification Services?


Some of the companies and industries that require bulk PAN verification services are:


### 1. Marketplaces for Vendor Onboarding


PAN card verification is part of KYC on many[online marketplaces](https://www.cashfree.com/payment-gateway-for-ecommerce/) . PAN verification allows you to verify your vendor’s legal name against PAN records. Doing so can help reduce the risk of fraudulent transactions and scams.


### 2. Large Enterprises for Employee Onboarding


For large companies, it may be impractical to do single PAN verification for each employee. It is more convenient to undertake PAN verification in bulk. With PAN verification, the employer can confirm the employee’s PAN details for TDS reporting and reduce errors caused by mismatched records.


### 3. Loan, Insurance, and Wallet Service Providers and Fintech Companies


Before disbursing funds, loan providers can confirm the identity of their customers through PAN as part of their checks. Likewise, insurance providers can do this verification via PAN, which serves as one authentication factor. Wallet or financial service providers can do PAN verification to help prevent fraudulent activities. Securities and equity investment platforms can also do PAN verification.


### 4. Customer Onboarding and KYC


PAN can be verified by wallet companies during[KYC](https://www.cashfree.com/blog/what-is-kyc/)[procedures](https://www.cashfree.com/grow/what-is-kyc/) or customer onboarding. Bulk PAN checks can help teams onboard large numbers of customers more quickly.


### 5. Asset Management Companies for Fund Transfers or Payments


To meet income tax reporting requirements, asset management companies may need to withhold tax and report it against the PAN of the payee. Fintechs, asset management companies and payment aggregators can perform PAN verification before transferring funds.
